rationale: Recent local results say extra output-head capacity is not the bottleneck, while recurrent-tail float rescue remains live. This edit removes the bigram output branch to cut bytes and hot-path work, then reallocates the export budget toward recurrent-tail value/projection tensors and final-block Q/K float keeps, targeting the final int8+zlib roundtrip metric rather than train loss.
title: Drop Bigram Head For Tail Value Float Rescue
